title: habenaria ensifolia var. khasiensis
intro: Habenaria ensifolia var. khasiensis, commonly known as the Khasi sword orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The health benefits of Habenaria ensifolia var. khasiensis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as combat bacterial and fungal infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
